restricted cash: in 24 period(s), 2019-12-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 24 period(s), 2019-12-31..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

basis break (four quarters vs the fiscal year, >1% apart — the quarters and the year were filed on different bases: restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations; those quarters carry basis_break_quarterly and the growth cells across them are blank): ocf: 2014-12-31 (286,670,000 vs 289,853,000); fincf: 2015-12-31 (72,340,000 vs 71,460,000); ocf_continuing: 2014-12-31 (286,670,000 vs 289,853,000)

growth across filing generations: 8 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): deferred_tax_liab (2024-12-31); fcf (2014-12-31); fcf_per_share (2014-12-31); ocf (2014-12-31); other_lt_assets (2022-12-31); owner_earnings (2014-12-31); owner_earnings_per_share (2014-12-31); selling_marketing (2011-12-31)
